response.description:
Azure
Data Box now supports ingestion of data into Azure
Files Provisioned v2 storage accounts. Azure Files Provisioned v2
is a billing model where customers provision and pay for specific capacity,
IOPS, and throughput values; giving greater flexibility and cost control for
file share workloads.  With this update, customers can
now use Azure Data Box to transfer data directly into Azure Files Provisioned
v2 storage accounts across most public regions.  Learn more: Unlocking
Flexibility with Azure Files Provisioned V2 Migrating
your on-premises data to Azure
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Data Box now supports Azure Files Provisioned v2
